description: This file defines serialization and deserialization logic, as well as deep copying, for the Collection<T> type in Orleans serialization framework. It includes classes for encoding/decoding collections and copying them, with support for reference tracking and size validation.

classes.name: CollectionCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for Collection<T>, handling writing, reading, and size validation for collection serialization.

classes.name: CollectionCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for Collection<T>, enabling deep cloning of collection instances and their elements.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Collection<T> to the wire format.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a Collection<T> from the wire format.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Writes a Collection<T> to the serialization stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Fills a Collection<T> from serialized data.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a Collection<T>.

methods.name: RecordCopy
methods.description: Records the deep copy of a collection instance in the copying context.
